topic: The mirror in the hostel washroom shows one extra person standing behind you.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Extra Reflection

shots.narration: The hostel mirror showed someone behind me, but I was alone.
shots.scene: Old Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, lantern between bashir and saad, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation.
shots.action: bashir points toward his own reflection in the lantern glass.
shots.mood: Warm lantern glow surrounded by deep blue darkness and low fog.

shots.narration: Saad leaned closer as I told him about last night.
shots.scene: Stone courtyard bench beside an old brass lantern, carved haveli arches behind it, vertical 9:16.
shots.mood: Quiet anticipation, long shadows across worn stone.

shots.narration: [whispers] I had stopped at an empty hostel during my rounds.
shots.scene: Flashback to an old Pakistani hostel corridor, open washroom doorway, cracked plaster, no signs or lettering, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: bashir carries his brass lantern into the washroom.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, thin floor mist, isolated amber lantern glow.

shots.narration: Inside, one mirror hung above a row of dusty sinks.
shots.scene: Hostel washroom with dusty porcelain sinks and one tall tarnished mirror, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: bashir places his lantern beside the nearest sink.
shots.mood: Greenish tiles, tarnished silver, heavy shadows beneath the sinks.

shots.narration: My reflection looked normal, until I noticed the doorway.
shots.scene: Washroom mirror reflecting bashir and the doorway behind him, actual doorway visible beside the mirror, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: bashir lifts his gaze toward the reflected doorway.
shots.mood: Still air, narrow amber highlights, darkness gathering around the mirror.

shots.narration: [surprised] Behind me, it stood open; inside the mirror, shut.
shots.scene: Angled washroom view clearly showing the actual open doorway and its closed reflection, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The reflected door swings shut while the actual doorway stays open.
shots.mood: Impossible geometry, cold reflected light against warm lantern glow.

shots.narration: Then a wet footprint appeared on the dusty floor.
shots.scene: Dusty washroom floor behind bashir's sandals, sink pedestal and lantern above, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: One wet footprint forms in the dust behind bashir.
shots.mood: Dark water against pale dust, tense stillness.

shots.narration: Another appeared, closer to my heels.
shots.scene: Close view of bashir's sandals and the dusty washroom floor, first footprint farther behind, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: A second wet footprint forms directly behind bashir's heel.
shots.mood: Tight framing, trembling lantern reflections in shallow water.

shots.narration: [whispers] In the mirror, a green hood rose behind my shoulder.
shots.scene: Tarnished washroom mirror reflecting bashir and saad's dark green hood, saad's face concealed in shadow, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The reflected saad rises into view behind bashir.
shots.mood: Deep hood shadows, pale mirror glare, cramped threatening composition.

shots.narration: I turned around, but the washroom was empty.
shots.scene: View away from the mirror toward empty washroom stalls and the open corridor doorway, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: bashir turns toward the empty stalls.
shots.mood: Vacant corners, motionless doors, moonlight across wet footprints.

shots.narration: Then your face appeared, Saad, pressed against the glass.
shots.scene: Washroom mirror showing saad's recognizable face behind the glass beside bashir's reflection, actual space behind bashir visibly empty, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The reflected saad presses his face against the inside of the mirror.
shots.mood: Extreme unnatural closeness, flattened cheek against glass, cold eyes, sharp lan

shots.narration: [whispers] Then why is its basement key in my pocket?
shots.scene: Return to the haveli courtyard bench, brass lantern between bashir and saad, vertical 9:16, no lettering.
shots.action: saad pulls a dripping old iron key from his hoodie pocket.
shots.mood: Pale startled faces, wet key gleaming above lantern light, darkness beyond the c

episode.endHook: What is waiting beneath the hostel, and why does Saad have its key?
episode.description: By lantern light, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about a hostel mirror that reflected someone who wasn't there. Then Saad recognizes something he shouldn't. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
